verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an official CLI (verified runtime: `npx -y supabase --version` works keylessly) documented extensively for local dev, migrations, and project management, and it is explicitly integrated into AI-native workflows (bundled with MCP server, agent skills discoverable via well-known endpoint, and installable via CLI commands like `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills`). missing for 10: no independent/third-party review specifically praising the CLI's AI-native ergonomics beyond Supabase's own docs.
